A closer look

Built for the way real teams work

Every capability earns its place, and translates to something you can feel.

Capability 01

Skills for each platform

WordPress, Joomla and Shopify each get an agent that knows the platform's own rules, not a generic one guessing.

Capability 02

Bounded actions

Install a plugin, edit a post, put a file in the media library. No shell, no arbitrary write, nothing the site did not name.

Capability 03

A record of every change

Each edit is recorded under its own id, so one call puts a whole deliverable back.
